name: Deanol bitartrate
description: Deanol bitartrate (CAS 29870-28-8 ), also known as DMAE bitartrate or DMAE tartrate, is the tartrate salt form of dimethylaminoethanol. It offers improved stability and water solubility compared to the free base form. It functions as a bioactive ingredient in nutritional and cosmetic formulations where controlled delivery and clean-label compatibility are priorities. In dietary supplements, it is used as the active ingredient in cognitive support. The bitartrate salt form supports consistent dosing and shelf stability in nootropic capsule and tablet formulations. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into firming creams and anti-aging serums for topical use. It contributes to skin-tightening effects in topical leave-on products. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as an active or excipient component in oral solid dose forms requiring precise pH buffering during processing. It also appears in functional beverage and powder blend applications targeting mental clarity positioning. Deanol bitartrate is supplied as a white crystalline powder for various industrial and commercial uses. Standard commercial grades include food-grade and USP -grade specifications. The latter is commonly required for pharmaceutical and supplement manufacturing to ensure high purity and safety standards. Bulk quantities are available for industrial procurement. Smaller technical-grade lots are also accessible for formulation development and pilot batches to meet specific research and development needs.
